summary: Jason Kandel combines two decades of reporting and editing in Los Angeles newsrooms with a proven record of adapting as digital media evolved. From producing award-winning investigative series at NBC and driving record traffic at KPCC/LAist to setting editorial AI guidelines, he has expanded his technical toolkit from web publishing to AI search. Today, he combines newsroom standards with search and AI strategy to position attorneys where it counts: quoted as experts by journalists and cited by AI bots.

items.description: Combining traditional media relations, connecting national and trade reporters with legal experts across business, tech, health, and entertainment, with modern digital strategy, including structuring website code, content, and metadata for search and AI search visibility.

Directed blog content generation and edited election articles and ballot measure guides. Established editorial and AI usage standards to ensure rigorous fact-checking, source transparency, and traditional newsroom reporting rules.
Planned content and wrote articles focused on boosting voter turnout and civic participation. Coached new writers on research, interviewing, source checking, and writing on deadline.

items.role: Senior Public Relations Specialist & Chief AI Strategist
items.description: Secured national media coverage for attorney clients in outlets such as The New York Times, The Guardian, and the Miami Herald, who provided their expert commentary on high-profile criminal cases, mediation, and legal angles on new state laws. Authored targeted press materials and bios that secured regular media placements and public profiles for clients.

Led breaking news coverage, managing reporting, editing, headline writing. Reported top-performing coverage on major legal and civil rights cases, including Jan. 6 prosecutions. Edited articles for accuracy, AP Style, and clarity while mentoring staff reporters.

Won first place recognition from the Los Angeles Press Club for a six-part crime story series that set site records for user engagement and traffic growth. Produced a three-part series on an industrial building explosion that prompted an EPA Superfund cleanup and drove state-level environmental health policy reforms. Led breaking news efforts, built interactive visuals, edited videos, and analyzed public records for major investigative projects.
Broke exclusive national news on deadline, covering high-profile infrastructure projects, national civil rights debates, and breaking investigative stories.

Spearheaded newsroom digital strategy and workflows to drive major year-over-year website traffic growth. Directed the station's first award-winning multimedia projects. Led a site redesign that boosted traffic by 50% and hired digital producers and the station's first blogger to cover Southern California's diverse communities.

items.company: Los Angeles Daily News (Southern California News Group)
items.description: Directed breaking news coverage for high-profile stories, boosting site traffic by 32% to 77 million page views. Launched the newsroom's first interactive databases, directed multimedia and video editing, and led staff web publishing trainings.
